_comment: Anti star-farming rules for the new-repo boards (tools/antiabuse.py, docs/ANTI_ABUSE.md). Thresholds were checked against every new-repo board in rankings/ (history replay). 'blocklist' applies to every board.

clone_clusters._doc: Repos from different owners with the same normalized repo name, or the same normalized description, form a cluster. Same description (>= min_desc_chars) across >= desc_min_owners owners, or same name across >= name_min_owners owners, is a clone cluster: every member is dropped, except the earliest member whose owner is credible (when one exists).

credible_owner._doc: Only used to keep the original of a clone cluster.

new_owner._doc: A user account younger than max_account_days when the repo was created, with fewer than max_followers followers. Alone: flagged and ranked last. Together with low_fork: dropped.

low_fork._doc: stars / (forks + 1). >= flag_ratio (and stars >= min_stars): flagged and ranked last. >= drop_ratio: dropped.

watch_farm._doc: subscribers_count (watchers) >= share x stars: dropped. Real new repos stay under ~10 %.

fork_farm._doc: forks >= share x stars: flagged and ranked last.

blocklist._doc: Case-insensitive. repos: owner/name. owners: account logins. names: repo-name regexes (full match). Applies to every board.
